speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The draft Bill was released for public consultation exercise from 26 June to 24 July 2015.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) has evaluated all the feedback received and, where relevant, accepted suggestions.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: These changes are in line with ongoing efforts by the Committee on the Future Economy.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: In particular, there will be even greater support to help companies grow and scale through internationalisation.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The final shareholding interest in a company to qualify an acquisition for M&A benefits will be lowered.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Clause 24 of the Bill provides for the changes.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This incentive will help Singapore companies transform their businesses and explore new areas of growth.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: It will also provide opportunities to help more Singaporeans gain international exposure for their work.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This will encourage more Singapore companies to expand overseas, while anchoring their key business activities in Singapore.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The enhancement to the Double Tax Deduction scheme and the introduction of the International Growth Scheme are provided for in clauses 18 and 34 of the Bill respectively.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Fourth, to enhance progressivity and strengthen future revenues, the personal income tax rates for tax resident individuals will be increased.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: There will also be smaller adjustments to the marginal tax rates for chargeable income between $160,000 and $320,000.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This change will take effect for income earned in 2016, in other 	Page: 111 words from YA 2017.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Fifth, the tax deduction for donations has been increased from 250% to 300% in 2015, as part of the SG50 Jubilee celebrations.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This is provided for in Clause 22 of the Bill.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: I shall now outline two other key changes arising from MOF's periodic review of the tax regime.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The first change is that we will exempt from tax, up to $400,000 of the amount either deemed withdrawn under the Supplementary Retirement Scheme (SRS) upon death of the SRS member or withdrawn in full on the ground of terminal illness or disease.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This will ensure parity on the amount of SRS savings that could have been withdrawn tax-free, had the amount been withdrawn over the full 10-year withdrawal period.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The change, which takes effect from YA2016, ensures that the SRS member is not unduly disadvantaged in the event of death, terminal illness or disease, and is provided for in clauses 7, 38 and 39 of the Bill.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The second amendment is to align the personal income tax rate for non-tax-resident individuals that is currently pegged to the highest resident marginal personal income tax rate, to the new top income tax rate for tax resident individuals, of 22%.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: At the same time, the withholding tax rate for non-resident individuals, which is currently pegged to the highest resident marginal personal income tax rate, will also be aligned to 22%.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This change will take effect from 1 January 2016.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Clauses 35, 36, 38 and 39 provide for this change.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The remaining legislative changes are mostly technical in nature or relate to improvements in tax administration.
